meta.name: baoyu-translate
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "translate", "翻译", "精翻", "translate article", "translate to Chinese", "translate to English", "改成中文", "改成英文", "convert to Chinese", "localize", "本地化", "refined translation", "精细翻译", "proofread translation", "快速翻译", "快翻", "这篇文章翻译一下", or provides a URL/file with translation intent. Supports three modes (quick/normal/refined) with custom glossary support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容翻译成多种语言
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高质量翻译或本地化内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality translation or localization

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能按快速、普通、精细三种模式翻译文本或文件，支持自定义术语表，并产出带分析、审校的完整译文。
howto.when: 当你要求“翻译”、“精翻”、“本地化”，或提供含翻译意图的链接/文件时触发。

say.text: 把这篇英文文章翻译成中文，用精细模式。
say.note: 触发精细翻译流程，包含分析、审校和润色。

say.text: 快速翻译这句话：Hello, how are you?
say.note: 直接输出译文，不经过分析步骤。

say.text: 帮我本地化这个文档，目标语言是日语。
say.note: 使用普通模式，并指定目标语言。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can translate text or files in three modes (quick, normal, refined), supports custom glossaries, and produces complete translations with analysis and review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "translate", "精翻", "localize", or provide a URL/file with translation intent.

say_en.text: Translate this English article to Chinese using refined mode.
say_en.note: Triggers the full refined workflow with analysis, review, and polish.

say_en.text: Quick translate this sentence: Hello, how are you?

say_en.note: Uses normal mode with specified target language.
